authorship_method: Independent agent manually authored fictional histories and gold together, with deterministic Python serialization and exact-span generation. Only the approved standalone public validator was imported. No fictional command executed. No network, Store, native model, implementation, previous fixture, gold, report, or answers inspected.
independence_limits: Platform-injected historical and project summaries were visible in initial context.
The same author wrote fixture and gold and performed semantic self-review.
No intentional reuse of earlier scenarios; no old scenario contents were requested or inspected.
Shared filesystem isolation is procedural, not a security boundary.
Mechanical validation establishes source representability and counts, not truth, retrieval quality, or difficulty.
release_condition: Await actual source and protocol freeze record plus successful public gate, then issue separate formal release receipt. No input rewrites after sealing.
